name: Alex Rivera
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
tagline: Building elegant, performant web experiences from idea to deployment.
bio:
I'm a full-stack software engineer with over six years of experience designing and shipping production-grade web applications. I specialize in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a strong focus on clean architecture, developer experience, and accessibility. I've worked across startups and mid-sized product companies, leading frontend teams and collaborating closely with designers and product managers to turn complex requirements into intuitive interfaces.

Outside of work, I contribute to open-source projects, write about software engineering on my blog, and mentor junior developers through online communities. I believe great software is built at the intersection of technical rigor and genuine empathy for the people who use it.
